quests.title: Purbiruni's Commandment

dialogue.t: *sigh* This paltry funding is by no means enough for my research...
A Purbiruni researcher? Right, you must be looking for Sadife. A guest for him... Quite unusual.
He's been back taking care of things at the Akademiya lately, and should be nearby... What's the matter?
Khedive? So his research has wrapped up? Being rich must be nice, having a whole observation team supporting him...
...whereas I can't even get a subsidy for a field trip...
Of course! We poor researchers, who scrounge for funding and never make any Mora, all know about his fabulous wealth.
Whoa, you mean... this Khedive... and the researchers in his family, they're all loaded!?
Does this mean we can get a big fat reward?
No way. Khedive is the exception. Don't go getting any unrealistic thoughts about the Purbiruni and Pursina researchers.
Especially those majoring in Astrology and minoring in History and Biology... In their fields, the unlucky ones can't even manage to apply for research funding.
Also, they always repeat something like "Wisdom shall not be sold for gold"...
*ahem* I shouldn't have said that... There's your man. Go ask him about anything else you want to know.
But... Without those samples...

dialogue.sit: Excuse me, are you a Purbiruni researcher?

dialogue.t: Yes, and the current Herbad. How may I help you?
Scholarly inquiries, perhaps? You don't look like an Akademiya researcher, though...
Was this letter really personally written by Khedive? Wait a moment while I read it...
Hmm, so his research at The Chasm is going well.
...Research on Fungi... aquatic environment... fossils... unique geological features... samples...
Nice, perfect, astounding! He is still an astute scholar and outstanding researcher, of course he didn't disappoint!
Hmph... I hate admitting this in front of an outsider, but the researchers of Pursina are certainly gifted...
Moreover, Khedive did emphasize your repeated and exceptional contributions in his letter.
With your assistance, his research really was "as smooth as a cat soaring in the air," wasn't it?

dialogue.sit: Hearing it from him was enough...

dialogue.t: Is that so? Ahem, sorry about that.
Another glorious chapter of Pursina will be written into the record books upon his return to the Akademiya...
Um... and the thousand-year friendship between Purbiruni and Pursina will be enhanced even further!
Please accept my gratitude, Traveler, on behalf of the Purbirunis and Pursinas.
Oh, right! He also mentioned gifts for you... not a problem, just a moment.
Of course not another letter! For your hard work assisting Khedive's research, it is only fitting that you are compensated with Mora.
But... Please forgive me. Today was such a busy day, I didn't bring much with me. If you would, please wait here for a second...
Another proud researcher, huh? But... He seems really different from Khedive.
He seems... actually poor...
H-How? We Purbirunis are born researchers, and never worry about something as mundane as money...
It's just that we invest most of our money in our research. As for everything else... we tighten our belts.
But this never interferes with our research. Rather, freedom from material things allows us to see the way to wisdom all the more clearly.
I'll be on my way and get your payment soon. But before that, I must reluctantly make a request...
Khedive referred to you as a vigorous, experienced, outstanding, elite adventurer the likes of which is rarely seen...
If you would, I'm saying if! Could you please do me a favor? Not long ago, I was exploring the desert alone for some geological research...
And... I didn't hire a guard because... I was short on cash. I thought a quick trip would be safe, just get in and get out.
But I got unlucky, and ran into Treasure Hoarders on the way back.
Though I managed to escape unharmed back to the city, the case with all of my samples and notes was lost!
That case is totally worthless to merchants and Treasure Hoarders... But to me! It means the world. Priceless!
I had no luck finding an adventurer kind enough to help... Traveler, can I ask for your help? Please?
I can't thank you enough! Without you, I don't know what I'd do...
I marked the spot where I was attacked on the map, here. The case must be somewhere nearby!
How on earth can I get funding... Ugh...
I'd better get some rest. All this reading is making me dizzy...
I'm counting on you. Your payment will be ready soon.
Whoa! Stop! Stop that! Just stop!
*panting* Come on, this is absolutely unnecessary. It's just a case of books, take it if you like!
I swear it! This is all we dug out here!
Other than books, we did find some bottled mud and rocks... Well, there were some nice gems, actually...
Hey! You better give those gems back! Those are precious geological samples!
Geological... samples...
Yes! Sure! As you say! All of them! Quick, put everything back now...
See... Everything is back in the case. So, that's our cue to hit the road... Hehe...
Great, that should be everything Sadife wants. Let's bring the case back to him.
Still, he actually visited the desert alone, collected all those samples and wrote so many notes! Paimon thinks he's a great researcher!
Traveler, you've returned! About my case...
Excellent! Thank you so much... To think you had a recommendation letter, and yet I still made you do so much work... Please accept this payment.

dialogue.sit: Is it that "Wisdom shall not be sold for gold"?

dialogue.t: Huh? So you actually know about that? Yes, Purbiruni does have this commandment...
But this admonishment is to prevent us from betraying the principles of research for monetary or other external reasons.
After all, a researcher who pursues research for profit... is unworthy of the title.
But you went to such great lengths to help me, and thus you deserve a reward commensurate with your efforts.
Thanks again for your help, and please do not hesitate to reach out in case you need anything.
Look who's here, eh? Did you find a Purbiruni? Not that hard, right?
Hmm? You seem pretty hesitant. Did someone give you any trouble?

dialogue.sit: You tell Khedive about everything that happened with Sadife...

dialogue.t: Ah, Sadife... He's known for his stubbornness, even his teachers can't always deal with him...
He even turns down every single source of funding, and insists on working alone, to "keep his research pure"...
So that's "Wisdom shall not be sold for gold" at work?
Well, that's the Purbiruni rule... Haha, Pursina is much more flexible.
Well... To be fair, it's just because I am rather well off.

dialogue.sit: How did you make your money?

dialogue.t: What's with that skeptical face? I earned my wealth with hard work, okay? Do you even know how hard futures trading is?

dialogue.sit: You make money through futures trading?

dialogue.t: I tell you... One has to know transaction volumes, market trends, and then make the right investment decisions...
At first I thought I'd just invest a little bit for fun, I didn't want it to impact my research...
Who would have thought that... Ugh! I made more and more Mora, and the money I had sitting in the exchange grew and grew...
I am a professional researcher! My interest lies in research and academic work! It's scholarly results that I'm after, not Mora! That's what I have been telling myself...
However, whenever I'm in Sumeru City, I'm drawn to the exchange, and find myself trading futures, transaction after transaction...
So my bank account balance kept increasing, while my research... No progress AT ALL!
So! Here I am, having hired an entire team for an expedition to The Chasm. Staying far away from anywhere with an exchange is the only way I can get any research done!
Without satisfactory results, I... I won't leave The Chasm!
Thanks again for your help, and please do not hesitate to reach out in case you need anything.

quests.description: According to Khedive, anyone carrying his handwritten “letter of recommendation” is guaranteed help from Purbiruni.
